review_kind: AI-reviewed translation (Claude, direct exact-source translation and technical self-review); no native-speaker signoff
review: Item 678 Home app-text pass: settings-group descriptions, preference and sound tooltips, theme and palette descriptions, the Make Masks diameter tooltip, the figure text-size tooltip and the Embeddings introduction were rewritten as factual descriptions without metaphors. Preserve backticked setting names, product names, numbers, units and paragraph breaks.

records.key: Turns each segmented object into a vector with a pretrained image encoder, alongside the measured panel rather than instead of it. Measured features describe properties chosen in advance; an embedding records the image features the encoder learned, which is useful when the phenotype is not yet defined. Per-channel encoding is the default. Every dimension then records the stain it came from. Interpret the dimensions together: a single dimension has no defined meaning.
records.source: Turns each segmented object into a vector with a pretrained image encoder, alongside the measured panel rather than instead of it. Measured features describe properties chosen in advance; an embedding records the image features the encoder learned, which is useful when the phenotype is not yet defined. Per-channel encoding is the default. Every dimension then records the stain it came from. Interpret the dimensions together: a single dimension has no defined meaning.
records.translation: 使用预训练的图像编码器将每个分割对象转换为一个向量，作为测量特征面板的补充而非替代。测量特征描述预先选定的属性；嵌入记录编码器学到的图像特征，适用于表型尚未定义的情况。默认按通道编码。此时每个维度都记录其来源的染色。应将各维度结合起来解读：单个维度没有确定的含义。

records.key:
Adds spaCR's DEBUG messages to the log files in ~/.spacr/logs. It also lets cellpose report which model it loaded, and it records which buttons you pressed. These records show the steps that led to a problem in a bug report.

Starting spaCR and opening its screens took no longer with this on. This was measured on one workstation by opening every module, once with this on and once with it off. Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.

Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.
records.translation:
将 spaCR 的 DEBUG 消息写入 ~/.spacr/logs 中的日志文件。此选项还允许 cellpose 报告加载的模型，并记录您按过的按钮。这些记录可显示错误报告中导致问题的操作步骤。

启用此选项后，spaCR 的启动和界面打开时间没有延长。测试在一台工作站上进行，在启用和关闭此选项时各打开每个模块一次。两种情况下，冷启动后 Home 都约在 4 秒内就绪。两种情况下，最慢的模块都约在 7 秒内打开。未测量流程运行时间。

Console 仍只显示您在 Logging 选项卡中为其启用的级别。此开关不会跟踪每次函数调用。该跟踪器是单独的开发者工具，此处的任何设置都不会启用它。

records.key:
Each level sets supersampling, render scale, the iteration budget and the scale below. Each of these remains a field that can be changed after a level is chosen.

Auto chooses the values for each backend from the hardware every time, instead of storing fixed values.
records.source:
Each level sets supersampling, render scale, the iteration budget and the scale below. Each of these remains a field that can be changed after a level is chosen.

Auto chooses the values for each backend from the hardware every time, instead of storing fixed values.
records.translation:
每个级别设定超采样、渲染比例、迭代预算以及下方的比例。选择级别后，这些值仍是可以修改的字段。

“自动”每次都根据硬件为每个后端选择数值，而不是存储固定值。

records.key:
Straight down descends to one point on the boundary and stays pointed at it — the steadiest picture, and what the published settings use.

Search as it goes periodically scores several directions around the centre by the set boundary they contain and moves the camera toward the highest score. The camera movement is visible; the Steering control below sets how far each move reaches.

Tour the interesting places measures the view as it descends and glides toward the part with the most colours in it, never toward a single-colour patch. The camera eases in and out of every move and turns away before the detail runs out, and at the end of a dive it glides back up. Dragging the view stops the tour; Ctrl+R hands the camera back to it.
records.source:
Straight down descends to one point on the boundary and stays pointed at it — the steadiest picture, and what the published settings use.

Search as it goes periodically scores several directions around the centre by the set boundary they contain and moves the camera toward the highest score. The camera movement is visible; the Steering control below sets how far each move reaches.

Tour the interesting places measures the view as it descends and glides toward the part with the most colours in it, never toward a single-colour patch. The camera eases in and out of every move and turns away before the detail runs out, and at the end of a dive it glides back up. Dragging the view stops the tour; Ctrl+R hands the camera back to it.
records.translation:
直线下降 下降到边界上的一个点并始终对准它——画面最稳定，也是已发布设置所用的方式。

边走边找 定期按所含集合边界的多少为中心周围的若干方向评分，并将镜头移向得分最高的方向。镜头的移动是可见的；下方的“转向”控件设定每次移动的幅度。

巡游有趣之处 在下降时测量画面，并滑向颜色最多的部分，绝不滑向单色区域。镜头在每次移动中都平缓开始和结束，在细节耗尽前转开，并在一次下潜结束时滑回上方。拖动画面会停止巡游；Ctrl+R 把镜头交还给它。

records.key:
How far the camera moves off a straight descent. 0 goes straight down; 1 makes the largest moves toward set boundary structure.

It sets how far each move reaches, how often one happens and how long it takes, together — a move never takes more than half the gap before the next, at any setting, so it always settles rather than being caught mid-course.
records.source:
How far the camera moves off a straight descent. 0 goes straight down; 1 makes the largest moves toward set boundary structure.

It sets how far each move reaches, how often one happens and how long it takes, together — a move never takes more than half the gap before the next, at any setting, so it always settles rather than being caught mid-course.
records.translation:
镜头偏离直线下降的程度。0 为直线下降；1 使镜头向集合边界结构做最大幅度的移动。

它同时设定每次移动的幅度、频率和持续时间——在任何设置下，一次移动的时长都不超过到下一次移动间隔的一半，因此移动总能完成，而不会在中途被打断。

records.key: Expected object diameter in pixels; 0 lets Cellpose estimate it. It is the only pre-SAM sizing setting that Cellpose 4 still uses, and it rescales the image by 30/diameter. Adjust it when objects are split or fused.
records.source: Expected object diameter in pixels; 0 lets Cellpose estimate it. It is the only pre-SAM sizing setting that Cellpose 4 still uses, and it rescales the image by 30/diameter. Adjust it when objects are split or fused.
records.translation: 预期对象直径（像素）；0 表示由 Cellpose 估算。这是 Cellpose 4 仍使用的唯一一项 SAM 之前的尺寸设置，它按 30/diameter 缩放图像。当对象被拆分或合并时调整此值。

records.key: Channel assignment, intensity normalisation and whether preview figures are drawn. The other groups use these values, so check them for each new dataset.
records.source: Channel assignment, intensity normalisation and whether preview figures are drawn. The other groups use these values, so check them for each new dataset.
records.translation: 通道分配、强度归一化以及是否绘制预览图。其他组使用这些值，因此每个新数据集都应检查它们。

records.key: Which detected objects are kept, for every object class in one place. `cell_min_size` and `nucleus_min_size` do the same thing to different objects. The settings are ordered by object, so the filters for one object are listed together. Raise the minimum size to drop debris, set a maximum to drop merged clumps, and use the border filters when objects cut off by the image edge would bias your measurements.
records.source: Which detected objects are kept, for every object class in one place. `cell_min_size` and `nucleus_min_size` do the same thing to different objects. The settings are ordered by object, so the filters for one object are listed together. Raise the minimum size to drop debris, set a maximum to drop merged clumps, and use the border filters when objects cut off by the image edge would bias your measurements.
records.translation: 针对每种对象类别，集中设置保留哪些检测到的对象。`cell_min_size` 和 `nucleus_min_size` 对不同的对象执行相同的操作。设置按对象排列，因此同一对象的过滤器列在一起。提高最小尺寸可去除碎片，设置最大尺寸可去除合并的团块；当被图像边缘截断的对象会使测量产生偏差时，请使用边界过滤器。

records.key: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type: shape family and method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method, and the intensity filters applied to detected objects. Choosing an organelle type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten. Punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods, and the organelle type selects one.
records.source: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type: shape family and method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method, and the intensity filters applied to detected objects. Choosing an organelle type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten. Punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods, and the organelle type selects one.
records.translation: 细胞器类型背后的四十八个检测参数：形状类别和方法、预先应用的背景和对比度校正、所选方法的参数，以及应用于检测到的对象的强度过滤器。选择细胞器类型会设置其使用的参数；在此处更改的值优先，且不会被覆盖。点状、管状和环状细胞器使用不同的方法，由细胞器类型选择其中一种。

records.key: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type. Choosing a type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten.
records.source: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type. Choosing a type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten.
records.translation: 细胞器类型背后的四十八个检测参数。选择类型会设置其使用的参数；在此处更改的值优先，且不会被覆盖。

records.key: Dropout and weight decay, which reduce overfitting to the training set, and gradient checkpointing, which reduces GPU memory use. Increase dropout or weight decay when training accuracy rises and validation accuracy does not.
records.source: Dropout and weight decay, which reduce overfitting to the training set, and gradient checkpointing, which reduces GPU memory use. Increase dropout or weight decay when training accuracy rises and validation accuracy does not.
records.translation: Dropout 和权重衰减（用于减少对训练集的过拟合），以及梯度检查点（用于降低 GPU 内存占用）。当训练准确率上升而验证准确率不上升时，增大 dropout 或权重衰减。

records.key: Run-level settings: verbosity, worker and batch sizing, background handling, and whether results are written. Use them to reduce console output, CPU or memory use, or to run without saving results.
records.source: Run-level settings: verbosity, worker and batch sizing, background handling, and whether results are written. Use them to reduce console output, CPU or memory use, or to run without saving results.
records.translation: 运行级设置：输出详细程度、工作进程数和批大小、背景处理以及是否写入结果。可用于减少控制台输出、CPU 或内存占用，或在不保存结果的情况下运行。

records.key: Detailed settings of the beta motility pipeline: feature selection and the filter windows applied to tracks. Change them after the basic assay runs, when the tracks show a specific error.
records.source: Detailed settings of the beta motility pipeline: feature selection and the filter windows applied to tracks. Change them after the basic assay runs, when the tracks show a specific error.
records.translation: Beta 运动性流程的详细设置：特征选择以及应用于轨迹的过滤窗口。在基本分析能够运行之后、轨迹出现特定错误时再更改这些设置。

records.key: Per-family parameters. Each applies to only some regression types, and a family refuses a setting it cannot read rather than ignoring it, so no setting here changes a fit silently. Change a parameter only when the chosen family documents it.
records.source: Per-family parameters. Each applies to only some regression types, and a family refuses a setting it cannot read rather than ignoring it, so no setting here changes a fit silently. Change a parameter only when the chosen family documents it.
records.translation: 各模型族的参数。每个参数仅适用于部分回归类型；模型族遇到无法读取的设置时会拒绝它而不是忽略它，因此此处的任何设置都不会在无提示的情况下改变拟合结果。仅当所选模型族的文档说明了某参数时才更改该参数。

records.key: Processing applied to the pixels before any mask is made: intensity normalisation, projection, upscaling, denoising, and field batching. Adjust it when the images are dim, noisy, or at a different scale from the one the model expects.
records.source: Processing applied to the pixels before any mask is made: intensity normalisation, projection, upscaling, denoising, and field batching. Adjust it when the images are dim, noisy, or at a different scale from the one the model expects.
records.translation: 在生成任何掩膜之前应用于像素的处理：强度归一化、投影、上采样、去噪以及视野分批。当图像较暗、噪声较大或尺度与模型预期不同时调整此组。

records.key: Everything that produces the pathogen mask: model and expected diameter, thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. Adjust this group when parasites packed into one vacuole are merged into a single object.
records.source: Everything that produces the pathogen mask: model and expected diameter, thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. Adjust this group when parasites packed into one vacuole are merged into a single object.
records.translation: 生成病原体掩膜的全部设置：模型和预期直径、阈值、背景去除，以及之后应用的尺寸、强度和边界过滤器。当同一液泡中聚集的寄生虫被合并为单个对象时调整此组。

records.key: All organelle mask settings, in setup order: shape family and detection method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method (adaptive, spot, ridge, ring, irregular, Cellpose or U-Net), the size, intensity and border filters applied to detected objects, and the parent compartment the results are summarised into. It is the largest group in the module because punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods.
records.source: All organelle mask settings, in setup order: shape family and detection method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method (adaptive, spot, ridge, ring, irregular, Cellpose or U-Net), the size, intensity and border filters applied to detected objects, and the parent compartment the results are summarised into. It is the largest group in the module because punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods.
records.translation: 所有细胞器掩膜设置，按设置顺序排列：形状类别和检测方法、预先应用的背景和对比度校正、所选方法（adaptive、spot、ridge、ring、irregular、Cellpose 或 U-Net）的参数、应用于检测到的对象的尺寸、强度和边界过滤器，以及汇总结果所用的父区室。由于点状、管状和环状细胞器使用不同的方法，这是该模块中最大的组。

records.key: Which plane of the stack holds each mask and each intensity channel, whether a cytoplasm compartment is derived, and whether the data is a time series. A wrong index measures the wrong object without an error, so check each index against the images.
records.source: Which plane of the stack holds each mask and each intensity channel, whether a cytoplasm compartment is derived, and whether the data is a time series. A wrong index measures the wrong object without an error, so check each index against the images.
records.translation: 堆栈中哪个平面包含每个掩膜和每个强度通道、是否派生细胞质区室，以及数据是否为时间序列。错误的索引会在不报错的情况下测量错误的对象，因此请对照图像检查每个索引。

records.key: The remaining parameters of individual regression families and plots: bootstrap counts, quantile and hinge parameters, solver tolerance and axis limits. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.source: The remaining parameters of individual regression families and plots: bootstrap counts, quantile and hinge parameters, solver tolerance and axis limits. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.translation: 各回归模型族和绘图的其余参数：自助法次数、分位数和 hinge 参数、求解器容差以及坐标轴范围。只有上方所选模型的参数才会生效。

records.key: Checks that test whether an attribution map depends on the model: insertion and deletion steps, the baseline they are measured against, and the model-weight sanity check. Run them before an attribution map is used in a figure.
records.source: Checks that test whether an attribution map depends on the model: insertion and deletion steps, the baseline they are measured against, and the model-weight sanity check. Run them before an attribution map is used in a figure.
records.translation: 检验归因图是否依赖于模型的检查：插入和删除步骤、度量所依据的基线，以及模型权重合理性检查。在将归因图用于图表之前运行这些检查。

records.key: Detection thresholds: the probability floor below which a candidate is discarded, the required flow agreement, and whether holes are filled. Adjust them when there are too many objects, too few, or one object where there are two cells.
records.source: Detection thresholds: the probability floor below which a candidate is discarded, the required flow agreement, and whether holes are filled. Adjust them when there are too many objects, too few, or one object where there are two cells.
records.translation: 检测阈值：候选对象低于该值即被丢弃的概率下限、所需的流一致性，以及是否填充孔洞。当对象过多、过少，或两个细胞处只有一个对象时调整这些设置。

records.key: The pixel dimensions the images are resampled to before any other step. A wrong value rescales every object and changes the meaning of the expected object size; set it once per acquisition.
records.source: The pixel dimensions the images are resampled to before any other step. A wrong value rescales every object and changes the meaning of the expected object size; set it once per acquisition.
records.translation: 在执行任何其他步骤之前，图像重采样所用的像素尺寸。错误的值会缩放每个对象并改变预期对象尺寸的含义；每次采集设置一次。

records.key: Training length and step size: epochs, learning rate, weight decay, batch size and augmentation. Adjust them when the loss stops decreasing early, or when the model overfits the training images.
records.source: Training length and step size: epochs, learning rate, weight decay, batch size and augmentation. Adjust them when the loss stops decreasing early, or when the model overfits the training images.
records.translation: 训练时长和步长：轮数（epochs）、学习率、权重衰减、批大小和数据增强。当损失过早停止下降，或模型对训练图像过拟合时调整这些设置。

records.key: Expected well composition: the number of distinct guides per well, the statistic used to assess it, and the read floor below which a well is treated as unreliable. The other checks use these values as their reference.
records.source: Expected well composition: the number of distinct guides per well, the statistic used to assess it, and the read floor below which a well is treated as unreliable. The other checks use these values as their reference.
records.translation: 预期的孔组成：每孔不同引导 RNA 的数量、用于评估的统计量，以及读数下限（低于该值的孔视为不可靠）。其他检查以这些值为参考。

records.key: Checks for two systematic artefacts to rule out before accepting a hit: counts that correlate with well position on the plate, and barcodes similar enough in sequence to be confused with each other. Both can resemble a biological effect.
records.source: Checks for two systematic artefacts to rule out before accepting a hit: counts that correlate with well position on the plate, and barcodes similar enough in sequence to be confused with each other. Both can resemble a biological effect.
records.translation: 在接受命中之前需排除的两种系统性伪影的检查：与孔在板上位置相关的计数，以及序列相似到可能相互混淆的条形码。两者都可能类似于生物学效应。

records.key: Whether preview figures are drawn, their size, and the number of examples. Turn them on to check the first plate of an experiment and off for later plates.
records.source: Whether preview figures are drawn, their size, and the number of examples. Turn them on to check the first plate of an experiment and off for later plates.
records.translation: 是否绘制预览图、其尺寸以及示例数量。检查实验的第一块板时开启，处理后续板时关闭。

records.key: Parameters specific to one estimator: the elastic-net mixing ratio, the fitted quantile, Huber's cut-off, the convergence tolerance, and the bootstrap counts behind the hinge and lasso selection thresholds. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.source: Parameters specific to one estimator: the elastic-net mixing ratio, the fitted quantile, Huber's cut-off, the convergence tolerance, and the bootstrap counts behind the hinge and lasso selection thresholds. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.translation: 特定于某个估计器的参数：elastic-net 混合比、拟合的分位数、Huber 截断值、收敛容差，以及 hinge 和 lasso 选择阈值所依据的自助法次数。只有上方所选模型的参数才会生效。

records.key: Screen design inputs fixed before plating: library size and redundancy, distribution over plates and replicates, the effect size to detect and its prevalence, sequencing depth, and the simulation settings for the estimate.
records.source: Screen design inputs fixed before plating: library size and redundancy, distribution over plates and replicates, the effect size to detect and its prevalence, sequencing depth, and the simulation settings for the estimate.
records.translation: 铺板前确定的筛选设计输入：文库规模和冗余度、在各板和重复间的分布、待检测的效应量及其流行率、测序深度，以及用于估算的模拟设置。

records.key: The target effect and its prevalence: the effect size to detect, the fraction of genes expected to show it, the background rate, and how well the readout separates a hit from a non-hit. Overestimating these values overestimates the power of the screen.
records.source: The target effect and its prevalence: the effect size to detect, the fraction of genes expected to show it, the background rate, and how well the readout separates a hit from a non-hit. Overestimating these values overestimates the power of the screen.
records.translation: 目标效应及其流行率：待检测的效应量、预期表现该效应的基因比例、背景率，以及读出区分命中与非命中的能力。高估这些值会高估筛选的检验效能。

records.key: Read the plate from cloud storage: credentials, endpoint and local cache, and the cloud folder the measurements are copied to when the run finishes. Not used for a plate on local disk.
records.source: Read the plate from cloud storage: credentials, endpoint and local cache, and the cloud folder the measurements are copied to when the run finishes. Not used for a plate on local disk.
records.translation: 从云存储读取板：凭据、端点和本地缓存，以及运行结束时测量结果复制到的云文件夹。不适用于本地磁盘上的板。

records.key: Which objects are linked across frames when the imported data is a time series. Not used for single-timepoint plates.
records.source: Which objects are linked across frames when the imported data is a time series. Not used for single-timepoint plates.
records.translation: 当导入的数据为时间序列时，哪些对象在帧之间关联。不适用于单时间点的板。

records.key: Least squares: minimises the summed squared residual and assumes the well residuals are approximately normal with one common variance. Use it as the reference for the other model families.
records.source: Least squares: minimises the summed squared residual and assumes the well residuals are approximately normal with one common variance. Use it as the reference for the other model families.
records.translation: 最小二乘法：最小化残差平方和，并假设各孔残差近似服从具有同一方差的正态分布。将其作为其他模型族的参考。

records.key: Least squares weighted by the well's cell count, so a well of 400 cells has more weight than one of 30. Use it when wells differ widely in the number of cells averaged into their score; ols weights every well equally.
records.source: Least squares weighted by the well's cell count, so a well of 400 cells has more weight than one of 30. Use it when wells differ widely in the number of cells averaged into their score; ols weights every well equally.
records.translation: 以孔的细胞数加权的最小二乘法，因此含 400 个细胞的孔比含 30 个细胞的孔权重更大。当各孔用于计算得分的平均细胞数差异较大时使用；ols 对每个孔赋予相同权重。

records.key: A short, quiet pluck in the sound set's key when you press a button, a switch, a tab, a list or a slider, confirming that the press registered.
records.source: A short, quiet pluck in the sound set's key when you press a button, a switch, a tab, a list or a slider, confirming that the press registered.
records.translation: 按下按钮、开关、选项卡、列表或滑块时，播放与音效组合同调的短促、轻柔拨弦声，确认按下已被接收。

records.key: A rising arpeggio that resolves onto the key's home note when a module's run finishes successfully, audible while spaCR is in another window.
records.source: A rising arpeggio that resolves onto the key's home note when a module's run finishes successfully, audible while spaCR is in another window.
records.translation: 模块运行成功结束时，播放一个上行琶音并解决到该调的主音上；spaCR 位于其他窗口之后时也能听到。

records.key: Pale, low-contrast colours for a faint backdrop.
records.source: Pale, low-contrast colours for a faint backdrop.
records.translation: 淡雅、低对比度的颜色，用于不显眼的背景。

records.key: Greys only: the backdrop moves without colour.
records.source: Greys only: the backdrop moves without colour.
records.translation: 仅灰色：背景移动时不带颜色。

records.key: Auroral emission lines: atomic oxygen at 557.7 nm (the dominant green), atomic oxygen at 630.0 nm (the red that appears only at high altitude), ionised nitrogen at 427.8 nm (the blue-violet lower fringe), and the pale yellow-green where the green and the red overlap.
records.source: Auroral emission lines: atomic oxygen at 557.7 nm (the dominant green), atomic oxygen at 630.0 nm (the red that appears only at high altitude), ionised nitrogen at 427.8 nm (the blue-violet lower fringe), and the pale yellow-green where the green and the red overlap.
records.translation: 极光发射谱线：557.7 nm 的原子氧（主要的绿色）、630.0 nm 的原子氧（仅在高海拔出现的红色）、427.8 nm 的电离氮（蓝紫色的下缘），以及绿色与红色重叠处的淡黄绿色。

records.key: Emission colours of a standard filter set: DAPI at 461 nm (blue), FITC at 519 nm (green), TRITC at 576 nm (orange-red), and the yellow where green and red overlap.
records.source: Emission colours of a standard filter set: DAPI at 461 nm (blue), FITC at 519 nm (green), TRITC at 576 nm (orange-red), and the yellow where green and red overlap.
records.translation: 标准滤光片组的发射颜色：DAPI 为 461 nm（蓝色），FITC 为 519 nm（绿色），TRITC 为 576 nm（橙红色），以及绿色与红色重叠处的黄色。

records.key: Indigo, violet, ice blue and pale periwinkle.
records.source: Indigo, violet, ice blue and pale periwinkle.
records.translation: 靛蓝、紫罗兰、冰蓝和淡长春花色。

records.key: Rose, magenta, dusty gold and plum.
records.source: Rose, magenta, dusty gold and plum.
records.translation: 玫瑰色、品红色、暗金色和梅紫色。

records.key: Gold, amber, pale gold and moss green.
records.source: Gold, amber, pale gold and moss green.
records.translation: 金色、琥珀色、淡金色和苔绿色。

records.key: Sea green, mint and teal.
records.source: Sea green, mint and teal.
records.translation: 海绿色、薄荷色和青绿色。

records.key: All specks move upward, as in the original starfield.
records.source: All specks move upward, as in the original starfield.
records.translation: 所有微粒向上移动，与原始星空效果相同。

records.key: All specks move downward.
records.source: All specks move downward.
records.translation: 所有微粒向下移动。

records.key: Each speck moves in its own random direction (Brownian motion) instead of one shared direction.
records.source: Each speck moves in its own random direction (Brownian motion) instead of one shared direction.
records.translation: 每个微粒沿各自的随机方向移动（布朗运动），而不是沿同一方向。

records.key: The text size used for every figure. Leave it unchanged to keep each figure's own text sizes. To resize one figure, use its right-click menu, under Figure settings.
records.source: The text size used for every figure. Leave it unchanged to keep each figure's own text sizes. To resize one figure, use its right-click menu, under Figure settings.
records.translation: 所有图使用的文本大小。保持不变则保留每个图各自的文本大小。要调整单个图，请使用其右键菜单中的“图设置”。

records.key: Channel assignment, intensity normalisation and whether preview figures are drawn. The other groups use these values, so check them for each new dataset.
records.source: Channel assignment, intensity normalisation and whether preview figures are drawn. The other groups use these values, so check them for each new dataset.
records.translation: 通道分配、强度归一化以及是否绘制预览图。其他组使用这些值，因此每个新数据集都应检查它们。

records.key: Which detected objects are kept, for every object class in one place. `cell_min_size` and `nucleus_min_size` do the same thing to different objects. The settings are ordered by object, so the filters for one object are listed together. Raise the minimum size to drop debris, set a maximum to drop merged clumps, and use the border filters when objects cut off by the image edge would bias your measurements.
records.source: Which detected objects are kept, for every object class in one place. `cell_min_size` and `nucleus_min_size` do the same thing to different objects. The settings are ordered by object, so the filters for one object are listed together. Raise the minimum size to drop debris, set a maximum to drop merged clumps, and use the border filters when objects cut off by the image edge would bias your measurements.
records.translation: 针对每种对象类别，集中设置保留哪些检测到的对象。`cell_min_size` 和 `nucleus_min_size` 对不同的对象执行相同的操作。设置按对象排列，因此同一对象的过滤器列在一起。提高最小尺寸可去除碎片，设置最大尺寸可去除合并的团块；当被图像边缘截断的对象会使测量产生偏差时，请使用边界过滤器。

records.key: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type: shape family and method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method, and the intensity filters applied to detected objects. Choosing an organelle type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten. Punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods, and the organelle type selects one.
records.source: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type: shape family and method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method, and the intensity filters applied to detected objects. Choosing an organelle type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten. Punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods, and the organelle type selects one.
records.translation: 细胞器类型背后的四十八个检测参数：形状类别和方法、预先应用的背景和对比度校正、所选方法的参数，以及应用于检测到的对象的强度过滤器。选择细胞器类型会设置其使用的参数；在此处更改的值优先，且不会被覆盖。点状、管状和环状细胞器使用不同的方法，由细胞器类型选择其中一种。

records.key: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type. Choosing a type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten.
records.source: The forty-eight detection parameters behind the organelle type. Choosing a type sets the parameters it uses; a value changed here takes precedence and is not overwritten.
records.translation: 细胞器类型背后的四十八个检测参数。选择类型会设置其使用的参数；在此处更改的值优先，且不会被覆盖。

records.key: Dropout and weight decay, which reduce overfitting to the training set, and gradient checkpointing, which reduces GPU memory use. Increase dropout or weight decay when training accuracy rises and validation accuracy does not.
records.source: Dropout and weight decay, which reduce overfitting to the training set, and gradient checkpointing, which reduces GPU memory use. Increase dropout or weight decay when training accuracy rises and validation accuracy does not.
records.translation: Dropout 和权重衰减（用于减少对训练集的过拟合），以及梯度检查点（用于降低 GPU 内存占用）。当训练准确率上升而验证准确率不上升时，增大 dropout 或权重衰减。

records.key: Run-level settings: verbosity, worker and batch sizing, background handling, and whether results are written. Use them to reduce console output, CPU or memory use, or to run without saving results.
records.source: Run-level settings: verbosity, worker and batch sizing, background handling, and whether results are written. Use them to reduce console output, CPU or memory use, or to run without saving results.
records.translation: 运行级设置：输出详细程度、工作进程数和批大小、背景处理以及是否写入结果。可用于减少控制台输出、CPU 或内存占用，或在不保存结果的情况下运行。

records.key: Detailed settings of the beta motility pipeline: feature selection and the filter windows applied to tracks. Change them after the basic assay runs, when the tracks show a specific error.
records.source: Detailed settings of the beta motility pipeline: feature selection and the filter windows applied to tracks. Change them after the basic assay runs, when the tracks show a specific error.
records.translation: Beta 运动性流程的详细设置：特征选择以及应用于轨迹的过滤窗口。在基本分析能够运行之后、轨迹出现特定错误时再更改这些设置。

records.key: Per-family parameters. Each applies to only some regression types, and a family refuses a setting it cannot read rather than ignoring it, so no setting here changes a fit silently. Change a parameter only when the chosen family documents it.
records.source: Per-family parameters. Each applies to only some regression types, and a family refuses a setting it cannot read rather than ignoring it, so no setting here changes a fit silently. Change a parameter only when the chosen family documents it.
records.translation: 各模型族的参数。每个参数仅适用于部分回归类型；模型族遇到无法读取的设置时会拒绝它而不是忽略它，因此此处的任何设置都不会在无提示的情况下改变拟合结果。仅当所选模型族的文档说明了某参数时才更改该参数。

records.key: Processing applied to the pixels before any mask is made: intensity normalisation, projection, upscaling, denoising, and field batching. Adjust it when the images are dim, noisy, or at a different scale from the one the model expects.
records.source: Processing applied to the pixels before any mask is made: intensity normalisation, projection, upscaling, denoising, and field batching. Adjust it when the images are dim, noisy, or at a different scale from the one the model expects.
records.translation: 在生成任何掩膜之前应用于像素的处理：强度归一化、投影、上采样、去噪以及视野分批。当图像较暗、噪声较大或尺度与模型预期不同时调整此组。

records.key: Everything that produces the pathogen mask: model and expected diameter, thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. Adjust this group when parasites packed into one vacuole are merged into a single object.
records.source: Everything that produces the pathogen mask: model and expected diameter, thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. Adjust this group when parasites packed into one vacuole are merged into a single object.
records.translation: 生成病原体掩膜的全部设置：模型和预期直径、阈值、背景去除，以及之后应用的尺寸、强度和边界过滤器。当同一液泡中聚集的寄生虫被合并为单个对象时调整此组。

records.key: All organelle mask settings, in setup order: shape family and detection method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method (adaptive, spot, ridge, ring, irregular, Cellpose or U-Net), the size, intensity and border filters applied to detected objects, and the parent compartment the results are summarised into. It is the largest group in the module because punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods.
records.source: All organelle mask settings, in setup order: shape family and detection method, the background and contrast correction applied first, the parameters of the chosen method (adaptive, spot, ridge, ring, irregular, Cellpose or U-Net), the size, intensity and border filters applied to detected objects, and the parent compartment the results are summarised into. It is the largest group in the module because punctate, tubular and ring-shaped organelles use different methods.
records.translation: 所有细胞器掩膜设置，按设置顺序排列：形状类别和检测方法、预先应用的背景和对比度校正、所选方法（adaptive、spot、ridge、ring、irregular、Cellpose 或 U-Net）的参数、应用于检测到的对象的尺寸、强度和边界过滤器，以及汇总结果所用的父区室。由于点状、管状和环状细胞器使用不同的方法，这是该模块中最大的组。

records.key: Which plane of the stack holds each mask and each intensity channel, whether a cytoplasm compartment is derived, and whether the data is a time series. A wrong index measures the wrong object without an error, so check each index against the images.
records.source: Which plane of the stack holds each mask and each intensity channel, whether a cytoplasm compartment is derived, and whether the data is a time series. A wrong index measures the wrong object without an error, so check each index against the images.
records.translation: 堆栈中哪个平面包含每个掩膜和每个强度通道、是否派生细胞质区室，以及数据是否为时间序列。错误的索引会在不报错的情况下测量错误的对象，因此请对照图像检查每个索引。

records.key: The remaining parameters of individual regression families and plots: bootstrap counts, quantile and hinge parameters, solver tolerance and axis limits. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.source: The remaining parameters of individual regression families and plots: bootstrap counts, quantile and hinge parameters, solver tolerance and axis limits. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.translation: 各回归模型族和绘图的其余参数：自助法次数、分位数和 hinge 参数、求解器容差以及坐标轴范围。只有上方所选模型的参数才会生效。

records.key: Checks that test whether an attribution map depends on the model: insertion and deletion steps, the baseline they are measured against, and the model-weight sanity check. Run them before an attribution map is used in a figure.
records.source: Checks that test whether an attribution map depends on the model: insertion and deletion steps, the baseline they are measured against, and the model-weight sanity check. Run them before an attribution map is used in a figure.
records.translation: 检验归因图是否依赖于模型的检查：插入和删除步骤、度量所依据的基线，以及模型权重合理性检查。在将归因图用于图表之前运行这些检查。

records.key: Detection thresholds: the probability floor below which a candidate is discarded, the required flow agreement, and whether holes are filled. Adjust them when there are too many objects, too few, or one object where there are two cells.
records.source: Detection thresholds: the probability floor below which a candidate is discarded, the required flow agreement, and whether holes are filled. Adjust them when there are too many objects, too few, or one object where there are two cells.
records.translation: 检测阈值：候选对象低于该值即被丢弃的概率下限、所需的流一致性，以及是否填充孔洞。当对象过多、过少，或两个细胞处只有一个对象时调整这些设置。

records.key: The pixel dimensions the images are resampled to before any other step. A wrong value rescales every object and changes the meaning of the expected object size; set it once per acquisition.
records.source: The pixel dimensions the images are resampled to before any other step. A wrong value rescales every object and changes the meaning of the expected object size; set it once per acquisition.
records.translation: 在执行任何其他步骤之前，图像重采样所用的像素尺寸。错误的值会缩放每个对象并改变预期对象尺寸的含义；每次采集设置一次。

records.key: Training length and step size: epochs, learning rate, weight decay, batch size and augmentation. Adjust them when the loss stops decreasing early, or when the model overfits the training images.
records.source: Training length and step size: epochs, learning rate, weight decay, batch size and augmentation. Adjust them when the loss stops decreasing early, or when the model overfits the training images.
records.translation: 训练时长和步长：轮数（epochs）、学习率、权重衰减、批大小和数据增强。当损失过早停止下降，或模型对训练图像过拟合时调整这些设置。

records.key: Expected well composition: the number of distinct guides per well, the statistic used to assess it, and the read floor below which a well is treated as unreliable. The other checks use these values as their reference.
records.source: Expected well composition: the number of distinct guides per well, the statistic used to assess it, and the read floor below which a well is treated as unreliable. The other checks use these values as their reference.
records.translation: 预期的孔组成：每孔不同引导 RNA 的数量、用于评估的统计量，以及读数下限（低于该值的孔视为不可靠）。其他检查以这些值为参考。

records.key: Checks for two systematic artefacts to rule out before accepting a hit: counts that correlate with well position on the plate, and barcodes similar enough in sequence to be confused with each other. Both can resemble a biological effect.
records.source: Checks for two systematic artefacts to rule out before accepting a hit: counts that correlate with well position on the plate, and barcodes similar enough in sequence to be confused with each other. Both can resemble a biological effect.
records.translation: 在接受命中之前需排除的两种系统性伪影的检查：与孔在板上位置相关的计数，以及序列相似到可能相互混淆的条形码。两者都可能类似于生物学效应。

records.key: Whether preview figures are drawn, their size, and the number of examples. Turn them on to check the first plate of an experiment and off for later plates.
records.source: Whether preview figures are drawn, their size, and the number of examples. Turn them on to check the first plate of an experiment and off for later plates.
records.translation: 是否绘制预览图、其尺寸以及示例数量。检查实验的第一块板时开启，处理后续板时关闭。

records.key: Parameters specific to one estimator: the elastic-net mixing ratio, the fitted quantile, Huber's cut-off, the convergence tolerance, and the bootstrap counts behind the hinge and lasso selection thresholds. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.source: Parameters specific to one estimator: the elastic-net mixing ratio, the fitted quantile, Huber's cut-off, the convergence tolerance, and the bootstrap counts behind the hinge and lasso selection thresholds. Only the parameters of the model chosen above take effect.
records.translation: 特定于某个估计器的参数：elastic-net 混合比、拟合的分位数、Huber 截断值、收敛容差，以及 hinge 和 lasso 选择阈值所依据的自助法次数。只有上方所选模型的参数才会生效。

records.key: Screen design inputs fixed before plating: library size and redundancy, distribution over plates and replicates, the effect size to detect and its prevalence, sequencing depth, and the simulation settings for the estimate.
records.source: Screen design inputs fixed before plating: library size and redundancy, distribution over plates and replicates, the effect size to detect and its prevalence, sequencing depth, and the simulation settings for the estimate.
records.translation: 铺板前确定的筛选设计输入：文库规模和冗余度、在各板和重复间的分布、待检测的效应量及其流行率、测序深度，以及用于估算的模拟设置。

records.key: The target effect and its prevalence: the effect size to detect, the fraction of genes expected to show it, the background rate, and how well the readout separates a hit from a non-hit. Overestimating these values overestimates the power of the screen.
records.source: The target effect and its prevalence: the effect size to detect, the fraction of genes expected to show it, the background rate, and how well the readout separates a hit from a non-hit. Overestimating these values overestimates the power of the screen.
records.translation: 目标效应及其流行率：待检测的效应量、预期表现该效应的基因比例、背景率，以及读出区分命中与非命中的能力。高估这些值会高估筛选的检验效能。

records.key: Read the plate from cloud storage: credentials, endpoint and local cache, and the cloud folder the measurements are copied to when the run finishes. Not used for a plate on local disk.
records.source: Read the plate from cloud storage: credentials, endpoint and local cache, and the cloud folder the measurements are copied to when the run finishes. Not used for a plate on local disk.
records.translation: 从云存储读取板：凭据、端点和本地缓存，以及运行结束时测量结果复制到的云文件夹。不适用于本地磁盘上的板。

records.key: Which objects are linked across frames when the imported data is a time series. Not used for single-timepoint plates.
records.source: Which objects are linked across frames when the imported data is a time series. Not used for single-timepoint plates.
records.translation: 当导入的数据为时间序列时，哪些对象在帧之间关联。不适用于单时间点的板。
